name: pop-pay
description: Project Point One Percent - Agent Pay \[pop-pay] is a payment guardrail and one-time flow protocol specifically designed for Agentic AI (e.g., Claude Code, OpenClaw). It enables agents to handle financial transactions safely without risking unlimited exposure of human-controlled credit cards.

rawRecord.description: Project Point One Percent - Agent Pay \[pop-pay] is a payment guardrail and one-time flow protocol specifically designed for Agentic AI (e.g., Claude Code, OpenClaw). It enables agents to handle financial transactions safely without risking unlimited exposure of human-controlled credit cards.

POP_CDP_URL.description: Chrome DevTools Protocol URL for card injection.

POP_MAX_DAILY.description: Maximum total amount allowed per day.

POP_STRIPE_KEY.description: Stripe secret key (sk_live_... or sk_test_...) for real virtual card issuing via Stripe Issuing.

POP_AUTO_INJECT.description: Enable CDP card injection into browser forms via Chrome DevTools Protocol (true/false).

POP_BILLING_ZIP.description: Billing ZIP code for auto-filling payment forms.

POP_BLOCK_LOOPS.description: Whether to block detected hallucination or retry loops (true/false).

POP_BYOC_NUMBER.description: Physical credit card number for Bring Your Own Card (BYOC) mode.

POP_BILLING_EMAIL.description: Billing email address for auto-filling payment forms.

POP_BYOC_EXP_YEAR.description: Card expiry year (e.g., 27) for BYOC mode.

POP_BILLING_STREET.description: Billing street address for auto-filling payment forms.

POP_BYOC_EXP_MONTH.description: Card expiry month (e.g., 12) for BYOC mode.

POP_GUARDRAIL_ENGINE.description: Guardrail engine type: 'keyword' for simple phrase blocking or 'llm' for semantic analysis.

POP_BILLING_LAST_NAME.description: Billing last name for auto-filling payment forms.

POP_ALLOWED_CATEGORIES.description: Vendors the agent is allowed to pay. Specified as a JSON array string.

POP_BILLING_FIRST_NAME.description: Billing first name for auto-filling payment forms.
